rounds.text: Kwality Pharmaceuticals Ltd is currently trading at a significant valuation premium, with a P/E of 44.3x compared to the sector benchmark of 31.97x [E6] and a P/B of 10.85x against a sector benchmark of 2.95x [E7]. This aggressive pricing is further highlighted by a reverse DCF analysis, which indicates that the current market price already demands an earnings growth rate of 18.8%, exceeding the base case assumption of 18.0% [E48]. The company’s financial quality is undermined by a concerning cash conversion ratio of 0.25x, suggesting that reported profits are not being effectively translated into operating cash flow [E34]. Furthermore, the company reported negative free cash flow of Rs -29 Cr in March 2026 [E36] and maintains high debtors of 203 days [E66]. While the stock has seen significant momentum, the price growth has consistently outpaced profit growth, with recent price appreciation exceeding profit growth by 145% [E58]. Conceded: the company has demonstrated strong historical growth metrics, including a 10-year compounded profit growth of 44% [E18] and a robust ROCE of 24.1% [E12].
